title: SonicWall security vulnerabilities
leadParagraph: SonicWall has released security updates to address vulnerabilities in SonicWall Global Management System (GMS) and SonicWall Analytics On-Prem . Exploitation of these vulnerabilities could allow for an attacker to gain unauthorized access to an affected system.
contentHtml:
SonicWall has released security updates to address vulnerabilities in SonicWall Global Management System (GMS) and SonicWall Analytics On-Prem . Exploitation of these vulnerabilities could allow for an attacker to gain unauthorized access to an affected system.

TT-CSIRT strongly encourages administrators to review the following releases from SonicWall and apply the necessary updates immediately:

  • SonicWall Global Management System (GMS)
  • SonicWall Analytics On-Prem
